column1: 5.5.4.6.7.4 Inter Pulse Display. This display feature facilitates the user to view the
graphical data of emitter parameters in various inter-pulse graphical formats. When this
option is clicked, LCIU shall send the corresponding plot ID to DSP to retrieve the graphical
data and displays it in the Inter-Pulse Graphical Display. For CW track, this tab is disabled.
